roadmap.title: Everyone Survives run
roadmap.description: Start a new game and follow the survival route, which also earns the chapter awards, the Hackett kills, the Silas kill, most story-choice awards and the tarot and evidence collections. Take Rocky Road in Chapter 2, answer MOVE ON to the old woman every time, and finish the story.

roadmap.title: Chapter 9 replay: reunite Laura and Max
roadmap.description: Back up the save, then replay from Chapter 9 so Ryan refuses the bite and Laura kills Travis.

roadmap.title: Everyone Dies replay from Chapter 4
roadmap.description: Replay from Chapter 4 and kill all nine playable characters. Take a tarot reading at a chapter end once during this run.

roadmap.title: Chapter 10 replay: Kaitlyn survives alone
roadmap.description: Replay Chapter 10 and trap Caleb in the freezer with the teddy.

roadmap.title: Chapter 9 replays: Ryan alone, then Laura and Travis
roadmap.description: Replay Chapter 9 so Ryan is the sole survivor, then replay Chapter 9 again without shooting Chris.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 replay: infect everyone and collect every clue
roadmap.description: Replay from Chapter 2, take Shady Glade, infect every character and gather all 40 clues in this one pass.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 replay: Peanut Butter Butterpops!
roadmap.description: Replay from Chapter 4 and hit every shot, including the kill on Jacob.

roadmap.title: Movie Night
roadmap.description: Start any Movie Night film from the main menu.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Prologue} to its end.
Play through @loc{Chapter 1} to its end.
Play through @loc{Chapter 2} to its end.

Play through @loc{Chapter 4} to its end.

Play through @loc{Chapter 6} to its end.

Play through @loc{Chapter 8} to its end.
Play through @loc{Chapter 9} to its end.
Play through @loc{Chapter 10} to its end.
Finish @loc{Chapter 10} and let the Epilogue play.

achievements.summary: Finish the story with all nine playable characters alive.

guide.context: Nine playable counselors must live (Abigail, Dylan, Emma, Jacob, Kaitlyn, Laura, Max, Nick and Ryan). Hacketts and Silas may die. Pass every quick-time event and @mechanic{Don't Breathe} event. A death carries forward, so replay from the chapter where it happened.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 1}: choose BREAK IN with @npc{Abigail} and @npc{Emma}, then keep the teddy bear. This makes @npc{Dylan} get bitten in @loc{Chapter 5}.
@loc{Chapter 3}: as Jacob, throw dirt at the hunter so the blood smear protects him later.
@loc{Chapter 4}: as Ryan, never shoot at the bushes (Jacob is there). As Emma in the tree house, pick SEARCH BAG first, not OPEN TRAPDOOR.
@loc{Chapter 5}: once the monster bites Dylan inside the radio hut, pick DESPERATE, then CHAINSAW to remove his hand.
@loc{Chapter 6}: as Abigail, shoot Nick when he turns on you.
@loc{Chapter 7}: as Laura, do not take or fire Travis's gun. Use the syringe on him instead.
@loc{Chapter 8}: stop Laura from shooting the caged monster. Choose HELP JACOB, pull breakers 1 and 2, pick CONTINUE, then pull breakers 2 and 3.

@loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, do not pull the knife out, accept Laura's bite and do not pull away. As Abigail, take the silver shells from the fuse box before climbing the ladder. Shoot monster Chris. At the scrapyard, warn Kaitlyn and pass the quick-time events.
@loc{Chapter 10}: as Max, choose STAY. As Kaitlyn, pick RUN, then BEAM, then investigate the noise to get the silver shells and shoot Caleb. As Laura, shoot Silas.

achievements.summary: Kill all nine playable characters in one playthrough.

guide.context: Replay from Chapter 4 after finishing the story. Hacketts do not need to die. Dylan must not be infected, so his hand is removed in Chapter 5. Shooting Travis in Chapter 7 is what makes him kill Laura later.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 4}: as Ryan, aim at the bushes, shoot, pick INSISTENT, and shoot again to kill Jacob. As Emma in the tree house, pick OPEN TRAPDOOR.
@loc{Chapter 5}: cut off Dylan's hand with the chainsaw.
@loc{Chapter 6}: as Abigail, do not shoot Nick. Let the timer run out.
@loc{Chapter 7}: as Laura, skip the syringe. Shoot Travis with his own gun in the cell.
@loc{Chapter 8}: do not stop Laura from shooting the caged monster, so Nick dies.

@loc{Chapter 9}: at the crane, pick WARN KAITLYN, SOUND HORN, then press nothing during the torch event so Dylan dies. As Ryan, shoot monster Chris; Travis then kills Laura. Pick AGGRESSIVE and fail the quick-time event so Travis shoots Ryan.
@loc{Chapter 10}: Max must pick SWIM TO SHORE. Kaitlyn must pick WAIT and then leave the gun alone.

achievements.summary: Survive Chapter 10 as Kaitlyn with every other playable character dead.

guide.context: Needs the teddy bear kept in Chapter 1 and left behind in Abigail's bag in the Chapter 5 kitchen (the Paths menu entry Down the Rabbit Hole shows the toy in her bag). Do it right after Hackett's Quarry Massacre by replaying Chapter 10. Without the Chapter 1 teddy bear, replay from Chapter 1.

steps.text: As Kaitlyn, pick RUN, BEAM, smash the button, then RUN.
Hide, enter the kitchen, then toss the teddy bear into the freezer.
Close the freezer door to trap Caleb.

achievements.description: Took the fastest route to Nick.
achievements.summary: Reach Nick by taking the fastest route in Chapter 3.

guide.context: Failing a shortcut quick-time event loses it. Replay from Chapter 3 if that happens.

steps.text: As Ryan in @loc{Chapter 3}, pick TAKE SHORTCUT both times and pass every quick-time event. You then see Nick dragged away.

guide.context: Laura and Travis must both be alive and working together (see Above the Law). That means Laura never fired Travis's gun in the Chapter 7 cell. If Laura fired Travis's gun in Chapter 7, replay from Chapter 7.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 10} as Laura, reach Silas's nest and shoot him. To also kill Travis for Family Matters, do not raise the gun first, fail the next quick-time event, then shoot Silas.

achievements.summary: Let Jacob tell Emma the truth in Chapter 10 while Emma is infected and Jacob is not.

guide.context: Emma must be bitten in Chapter 4 and again in Chapter 6. Jacob must never be bitten. Do not use silver ammo on Emma in Chapter 8. If Emma's two Chapter 4 failures are missed, Jacob is bitten, or silver is used in Chapter 8, replay from Chapter 4.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 4}: as Emma, pick SEARCH BAG, USE TASER, TAKE PHOTO. In the chase pick down, smash, then SPRAY, up and up. Pick BLOCK DOOR and USE TRAPDOOR. Then do down, deliberately fail, right, deliberately fail, up.
@loc{Chapter 6}: win Jacob's quick-time events and pick PRY OPEN. As Emma near the hunters, pick RUN.
@loc{Chapter 8}: as Kaitlyn at the van, pick SHOOT three times and choose REGULAR SHOT. As Ryan, pick HELP JACOB, pull breakers 1 and 2, CONTINUE, then 2 and 3.
@loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, shoot monster Chris.
@loc{Chapter 10}: after Kaitlyn inspects the portrait, pick HONEST, REMORSEFUL, APOLOGETIC in the Jacob and Emma scene.

achievements.summary: Let Nick kill Abigail in Chapter 6.

steps.text: In the @loc{Chapter 6} pool house, pick CALM and COMPASSIONATE as Abigail. When she aims the shotgun at Nick, press nothing until the timer ends.

achievements.summary: Reunite Laura and Max in Chapter 10.

guide.context: Laura cannot have fired Travis's gun in Chapter 7. Replay from Chapter 9 after finishing the story.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, decline Laura's bite. After the attic fall, shoot monster Chris. Ryan then bleeds out.
As Laura, win the quick-time event and shoot Travis with the shotgun.
@loc{Chapter 10}: play Max and cross to the far side of the island to start the reunion.

achievements.description: Travis and Laura agreed to work together
achievements.summary: Have Travis and Laura agree to work together.

guide.context: Earned at the end of Chapter 9. The Paths menu lists its progress under its own Above the Law entry. It depends on the Chapter 7 choices about Travis. If it fails, replay from Chapter 7.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 7}: as Laura, inspect the left wall, take the spoon from the bed, and loosen the stone. Take the syringe from the locker in the third upstairs office and hide it in the stone. Do not take or fire Travis's gun. Go to sleep, then inject Travis in the quick-time event.
@loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, shoot monster Chris. When Travis does not stab Laura, pick SUSPICIOUS.

achievements.description: Laura and Travis killed each other.
achievements.summary: Have Laura and Travis kill each other.

guide.context: Replay Chapter 9 after finishing the story.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 9}: when Ryan aims at monster Chris, do not shoot. Laura stays a monster and fights Travis.

achievements.summary: Save Dylan from infection by cutting off his hand.

guide.context: In Chapter 1, choose BREAK IN with Abigail and Emma. Without it, Dylan is not bitten in Chapter 5. If Dylan is not bitten in Chapter 5, replay from Chapter 1.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 5}: in the radio hut, pick INTERESTED, CONCERNED, APOLOGETIC, press nothing when aiming at the ceiling, then AGGRESSIVE and the choices that follow. After Dylan is bitten, pick DESPERATE and then CHAINSAW.

achievements.description: Accepted the bite of a werewolf.

guide.context: Only available in Chapter 9. Replay Chapter 9 if you miss it.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 9}, as Ryan bleeding out, pick SYMPATHETIC, then ACCEPT. Do not press the pull-away prompt.

achievements.summary: Finish the story with Ryan as the only survivor.

guide.context: Replay from Chapter 9 after Hackett's Quarry Massacre, so Laura shot Travis in Chapter 7.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, do not pull the knife. Mash the button to push the cabinet against the door. When Bobby catches you, pick STAB. Accept Laura's bite.
At the crane, warn Kaitlyn and fail the torch event so Dylan dies. Shoot monster Chris; Travis kills Laura. Shoot Travis.
@loc{Chapter 10}: Max must pick SWIM TO SHORE. Kaitlyn must pick WAIT and then leave the gun alone.

guide.context: Kaylee dies automatically in Chapter 5. Caleb needs either the silver shells (Abigail takes them in the Chapter 9 bunker, and Abigail and Emma must both live) or the teddy bear kept in Chapter 1 and left in the Chapter 5 kitchen. Travis depends on how Laura handled him in Chapter 7. If a kill is missed, replay from the chapter of the missed choice.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 9}: as Laura, smash the button to shoot Constance in the gun struggle.
@loc{Chapter 9}: as Laura meeting Jedediah, pick ATTACK after the quick-time events.
@loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, do not pull the knife, then pick STAB on Bobby. A monster kills him later. Shoot monster Chris.
@loc{Chapter 10}: as Kaitlyn, shoot Caleb with the silver shells, or trap him in the freezer with the teddy bear.
Travis: if Laura shot him in Chapter 7, he kills Laura in Chapter 9 and Ryan shoots him. Otherwise, in Chapter 10 do not raise the gun at Silas and fail the quick-time event so Travis is shot.

guide.context: Max, Laura and Nick are always bitten. Max must be bitten in the Prologue. Don't Breathe events cannot be set to AUTO. Replay from Chapter 2 and combine with the all-clues run. The Chapter 1 BREAK IN must already be done in the save you replay from.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 1}: choose BREAK IN as Abigail.
@loc{Chapter 3}: choose HELP NICK, RUN, do not climb the tree, and fail the @mechanic{Don't Breathe} event so Abigail is bitten.
@loc{Chapter 4}: get Emma bitten with the tree house route shown under Nobody's Fool.
@loc{Chapter 5}: after Dylan is bitten, pick TERRIFIED. Do not cut off his hand.
@loc{Chapter 6}: as Jacob, fail the first running quick-time event, win the others and pick PRY OPEN.
@loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, pick ACCEPT and do not press the pull-away prompt. At the crane, pick WARN KAITLYN, SLAM CAR, and fail the mash event to bite Kaitlyn.

achievements.summary: Play the podcast on Travis's computer in Chapter 7.

steps.text: As Laura in the free-roam @loc{police station}, inspect the birthday card in the first upstairs office and the calendar in the third. Then use the computer in the downstairs corner office.

guide.context: The count carries across playthroughs. Steam shows progress.

steps.text: Press the button on interrupt prompts during cutscenes. Skip any whose result would harm a goal.

guide.context: Release the button only after the screen stops flashing. The AUTO setting does not count.

steps.text: Hold the button during each @mechanic{Don't Breathe} prompt, then release once the red flashing stops.

achievements.description: Never missed in a combat encounter
achievements.summary: Hit every shot in every combat encounter in one playthrough.

guide.context: Cannot be combined with the survival run because Jacob must die in Chapter 4. Replay from Chapter 4 only if Chapters 1 to 3 already followed the steps below; otherwise replay from Chapter 1. Unlocks as the Epilogue begins. Keep aim assist off.

steps.text: @loc{Chapter 1}: choose BREAK IN with Abigail and Emma.
@loc{Chapter 2}: as Nick at the shooting range, shoot the left melon, shoot it again after the cutscene, then shoot the 2 far-left bottles and 1 bottle on the left.
@loc{Chapter 3}: as Ryan, take both shortcuts, pick SHOUT, then shoot and hit the hunter Bobby.
@loc{Chapter 4}: as Ryan at the bushes, do not shoot the first time. Shoot the second time and kill Jacob.
@loc{Chapter 5}: as Kaitlyn on the stairs, win the first quick-time event, fail the next two, and shoot the table held by Bobby. In the radio hut, Ryan fires at the ceiling.
@loc{Chapter 6}: as Abigail, shoot Nick.
@loc{Chapter 7}: use the syringe on Travis.
@loc{Chapter 8}: do not stop Laura.
@loc{Chapter 9}: as Ryan, accept the bite; as Abigail, take the silver shells. Shoot Chris.
@loc{Chapter 10}: Kaitlyn picks WAIT and SHOOT, then BEAM and the smash prompt, then RUN, INVESTIGATE and a final SHOOT. As Laura at the nest, pick RAISE GUN and shoot Silas.

achievements.summary: Refuse the old woman's tarot reading at the end of every chapter in one playthrough.

guide.context: Do it in the survival run. Picking up a tarot card is fine. Any other answer ends the attempt. Start a new run from the chapter where it was given, and answer MOVE ON every time.

steps.text: Whenever the old woman offers a reading at a chapter end, pick MOVE ON.

achievements.summary: Find all 22 tarot cards in one playthrough.

guide.context: Take Rocky Road in Chapter 2 for The Hanged Man. The clues Trail Camera and Ranger Box need Shady Glade instead, so tarots and clues need different runs. The achievement unlocks in Chapter 10.

guide.context: One piece per chapter. Bloated Corpse needs STEAL ROTATOR ARM in Chapter 1; replay from Chapter 1 if it was skipped. The achievement unlocks in Chapter 10.
